title: Gold-level universal design dwelling seeking the site area variation: gold level and maximum 90 m2
text: Accessible dwellings that seek to apply the gold level universal design site area variation as part of 4.0 - Land, C4.1.5 or C4.1.6 shall; i. be designed and constructed in accordance with the gold level universal design requirements of A4 Universal design requirements, or are certified Livable Housing Australia to a minimum gold level of performance; and ii. have a maximum internal floor area of 90m2. Note: All other provisions of the R-Codes still apply.

replaces.note: Part B accessible dwelling (R30 and R40, 110 m2) replaced by the Part C pathway at 90 m2, register C4P1-153

notes: from: ch3 C2.7.2. diverges: maximum internal floor area 90 m2 (Chapter 3: 110 m2), and the variation is under C4.1.5 or C4.1.6 (Chapter 3: C4.1.6 or C4.1.7). Applies only where the applicant seeks the gold-level site area variation. Register C4P1-153 records the deleted Part B 5.5.4 provision.
